tools.name: market_catalogue
tools.description: Free routes, prices, live coverage and available archive dates.

tools.description: One free historical record from 13 November 2026 and the evaluation dataset link. Not a live feed.

tools.name: quote_getLatestNews
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/news/latest request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Latest crypto news with AI sentiment scores, plus stock, forex and macro news.

tools.name: quote_cryptoNewsSentimentApi
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/crypto-news request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Crypto news API with AI sentiment scores: crypto headlines only.

tools.name: quote_getLatestAnnouncements
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/announcements/latest request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Latest Binance announcements and new listings with AI sentiment scores.

tools.name: quote_getNewsDay
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/news/day request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Historical crypto news for backtests: one UTC day since 2023, point-in-time.

tools.name: quote_getListingEvents
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/events/listings request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Binance new listing and delisting alerts.

tools.name: quote_getAnnouncementHistory
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/announcements/history request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Binance listing and announcement history by year since 2017, for backtests.

tools.name: quote_buyWeekPass
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid offer for 7-day access pass; no key is created until settlement.

tools.name: quote_buyMonthPass
tools.description: Prepare an unpaid offer for 30-day access pass; no key is created until settlement.
